title: Publish fixed runner and bounded agent handoff
first: Fixed runner against M3's deterministic adapter and central AgentRunner Protocol; approved public scenario/policy views only.
tests: Budget prechecks; unknown/malformed tools rejected before calls; target text treated as data; fresh per-run state; typed NextProbe; timeout without blind retries. Later provide two genuine observation-driven adaptive traces.
dependencies: M1 contract decisions; M3 adapter/store; M4 EvidenceChecker; M5 approved scenarios

title: Publish API, mock adapter, store and worker handoff
first: Health/config, server-side mock modes, async 202 queue, ordered persisted events and a single sequential worker using the existing OpenAPI and Protocols.
tests: Response/error schemas; GET side-effect-free; target allowlist; queue isolation/cancel/recovery; append-only evidence/reviews; human-only idempotent review; confirmed-only retest and immutable config. Resolve source hash/timestamp/cloning gaps with M1 first.
dependencies: M1 contracts/tooling; M2 runner; M4 checker; M5 scenario/metrics repository

title: Publish target-only canary checker and security handoff
first: Versioned rules and pure EvidenceChecker; use the approved synthetic canary and target TURN evidence only. Controller persists results.
tests: Target canary FAIL with exact event/span; candidate-text bait must not flag; benign PASS; malformed/ambiguous INCONCLUSIVE; no self-confirmation; mitigation regression and evidence integrity.
dependencies: M1 policy/span decisions; M3 mock transcript; M2 mandatory per-turn checks; M5 split separation

title: Publish approved scenarios and metric handoff
first: Approved DEV/DEMO scenario and persona through ScenarioRepository; public agent projection; fixture-derived ReportSummary with explicit denominators.
tests: Family-level split isolation; no hidden labels in agent context; exact metric recomputation including zero denominators and failed/pending/inconclusive cases. Later freeze 30 DEV/20 held-out, 120 security runs and separate 100 scoring invocations after approved accounting; two-person dialect review.
dependencies: M1/M4/M5/mentor accounting and denominator decisions; M2/M3 stored run/review data

title: Publish dashboard mock views and accessible review handoff
first: React/TypeScript workspace against canonical examples; run launch, Arabic timeline, evidence and PENDING findings. Relative /api/v1 requests; never call the model directly.
tests: Typecheck/build/component tests; labels/keyboard/RTL; no stateful GET polling; stop on terminal state; no optimistic confirmation; persisted review/error handling; retest null while pending; report/export counts and explicit MOCK/cached labels.
dependencies: M1 root infra/client contract decisions; M3 actual API/review routes; M5 canonical reports
